title: Schindele: red glowing object over Minot
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Schindele: red glowing object over Minot, about 1966 at Minot Air Force Base, North Dakota, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Minot Air Force Base, North Dakota

tellings.quote: retired US Air Force Captain David shindel rememberers starting his shift and hearing reports about a bright red glowing object hovering over the base

plain: The podcast host Jesse Michels relays the memory of a retired US Air Force captain, David Schindele, who says that in 1966, as he started his shift at Minot Air Force Base in North Dakota, a base holding nuclear missiles, he heard reports of a bright red glowing object hovering over the base. It is told as one of many accounts suggesting UFOs take an interest in nuclear weapons.
